subject: Operations
title: The Cost of Cutting Corners
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Cost of Cutting Corners.

hook.text: Every operations disaster in this course shares one root cause: someone decided a shortcut was worth the risk.

buildup.text: Shortcuts save money in the short term: less testing, fewer suppliers, cheaper materials, faster timelines.

discovery.text: But the hidden costs compound: recalls, lawsuits, lost customers, destroyed reputations, and sometimes lost lives.

twist.text: Companies that survived invested heavily in prevention afterward—paying more than the shortcut ever saved.

climax.text: The lesson is universal: invest in quality, safety, and resilience upfront. Failure always costs more than prevention.

punchline.text: Shortcuts are the most expensive path in operations.

quiz.question: What do all major operations failures have in common?
options: Someone took a shortcut they shouldn't have
